name: Seeping Darkness [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your innate magical darkness seeps through your skin and strengthens when you’re near another creature whose soul is as wicked as yours.

Prerequisite(s): Drow, darkness ancestral spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): Whenever you’re adjacent to a drow ally, you can spend a move action to grant said drow ally concealment (20% miss chance) for 1 round.
